results.answer: Worksheet: Orders grain=one row per order_id; measure=Orders.amount; Items grain=one row per item_id; relationship=one order to many items; filter=Items.category='book'; grouping=Orders.region; aggregation=sum(Orders.amount). Sequence: join Orders to filtered Items, group by region, sum Orders.amount. Risk: orders with multiple book items produce repeated Orders.amount values, overstating totals. No approved deduplication rule exists. Measure status: unsupported as proposed because the join changes the order grain before summation. Supported alternative: first derive distinct order_id values from filtered book Items, then join those IDs to Orders and sum each Orders.amount once by region. Verification: compare qualifying distinct order counts with joined rows; confirm each qualifying order contributes exactly one amount; reconcile regional totals to the sum of qualifying Orders.amount values.
